strings.commentinline_help: If enabled, the submission text will be copied into the feedback comment field during grading, making it easier to comment inline (using a different colour, perhaps) or to edit the original text.
strings.commentinlinedefault_help: If set, this comment inline functionality will be enabled by default for all new assignments.
strings.default_help: If set, this feedback method will be enabled by default for all new assignments.
strings.enabled_help: If enabled, the marker can leave feedback comments for each submission.
strings.privacy:metadata:filepurpose: Feedback files from the teacher for the student.
strings.privacy:metadata:gradepurpose: The grade ID associated with the comment.
strings.privacy:metadata:tablesummary: This stores comments made by the graders as feedback for the student on their submission.
